taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
* clk=1 (hold): switch gates ramp to vss, bootstrap caps recharged to VDD.
* clk=0 (track): cap inserted between vin and gate -> VGS ~= VDD, input-independent.
* Hold-start sequence: quench boost pass (MP5 kicks B to vdd), fast clean gate
* ramp (MN8) against a static boosted rail (bottom plate stays pinned to vin
* via MN10 whose gate pg1 stays high). Recharge is self-timed: a per-side
* NOR(gate, ckb) fires once the gate has fallen well below the switch VT
* crossing, then MN1/MP1 recharge the bootstrap cap.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* Internal inverted clock (ckb high during track).
XINVP ckb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINVN ckb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ============ P side ============
* Bootstrap storage capacitor (ideal C permitted).
CBP topp botp 3p
* Self-timed recharge trigger: rc_p = NOR(gatep, ckb) goes high during hold
* only after gatep has fallen to ~0.6 V (sampling crossing complete).
XNPAP xp ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNPBP rc_p gatep xp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XNNAP rc_p gatep vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNNBP rc_p ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Recharge: bottom plate to vss, top plate to vdd.
XMN1P botp rc_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMP1P topp pg1p vdd topp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* pg1: tracks top plate during track and the gate-ramp window (MP1 off,
* MN10 on), pulled to 0 by the trigger (MP1 charges top, MN10 releases).
XMN7P pg1p rc_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP3P pg1p bp topp topp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Control node B: vdd during hold (MP2 quenched), 0 during track (MP2 on).
XM9P bp ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP5P bp ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Boost pass device: top plate to switch gate during track.
XMP2P gatep bp topp topp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* Hold-phase gate pulldown: ramps the gate through the switch VT crossing
* against a static boosted rail; width tuned for minimum aperture HD3.
XMN8P gatep clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* Track-phase bottom plate connection to the input: bootstrapped NMOS only
* (gate = pg1 = top plate, so VGS = VC at every vin; no PMOS knee).
XMN10P botp pg1p vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4

* ============ N side ============
CBN topn botn 3p
XNPAN xn ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNPBN rc_n gaten xn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
XNNAN rc_n gaten vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNNBN rc_n ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN1N botn rc_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMP1N topn pg1n vdd topn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMN7N pg1n rc_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP3N pg1n bn topn topn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM9N bn ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP5N bn ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP2N gaten bn topn topn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN8N gaten clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMN10N botn pg1n vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4

.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
* clk = 0: track (gate driven to ~vin + VDD); clk = 1: hold (gate clamped to 0).

* One single-ended bootstrap channel.
.subckt bgd_half vdd vss clk clkb clkd d1 vin gate
* Bootstrap reservoir capacitor (ideal C permitted for bootstrap storage).
CB top bot 6p
* Bottom plate: clamped to vss during hold (delayed clock), tied to vin while
* tracking through a gate-bootstrapped switch (constant VGS = VDD).
XMBN bot clkd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMBS bot gate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=4
* Top plate recharged to VDD during hold through M3 (gate driven to ~2*VDD).
XM3 vdd d1 top vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
* Boosted pass device: connects top plate to the switch gate while tracking.
XM5 gate x top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
* X-node control: MX1 ties x to top while gate is low (keeps M5 off in hold);
* cascoded pulldown enables M5 during tracking; MX3 kicks x up at clk rise.
XMX1 x gate top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMXC x vdd xm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMX2 xm clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMX3 vdd clk x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* Gate pulldown: cascoded, fires immediately on the hold edge.
XMGC gate vdd gm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMGN gm clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
.ends bgd_half

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* Local clock phases.
XIB1P clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XIB1N clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XIB2P clkd clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XIB2N clkd clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* Clock doubler: d1 ~ 2*VDD while clk is high, recharges the top plates.
CD1 d1 clk 300f
CD2 d2 clkb 25f
XMD1 d1 d2 vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMD2 d2 d1 vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Two matched single-ended bootstrap channels.
XHP vdd vss clk clkb clkd d1 vinp gatep bgd_half
XHN vdd vss clk clkb clkd d1 vinn gaten bgd_half
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrapped gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
*   clk = 0  -> track  : gate = vin + Vboot  (constant VGS on the sampling FET)
*   clk = 1  -> hold   : gate = vss          (sampling FET off)
*
* One bootstrap core per side; a shared clock chain supplies the complement
* clkb and a slightly delayed in-phase clkd.  clkd fires the gate/bottom-plate
* pull-downs only after the boosted transfer PMOS has been shut off, so the
* boost capacitor is not discharged into ground on every sampling edge.

**********************************************************************
* Single-ended bootstrap core
*
*   ntop / nbot are the boost-capacitor plates.
*   Hold  : ntop -> vdd, nbot -> vss, gate -> vss   (capacitor refreshed)
*   Track : ntop -> gate, nbot -> vin              (capacitor floats on vin)
*
*   nag / npg are the boosted-domain gate drives for the charging PMOS and
*   the transfer PMOS.  A cross-coupled latch whose pull-ups sit on ntop
*   generates them, so both PMOS devices see VGS = 0 exactly when off, even
*   with ntop well above vdd.  The clocked NMOS legs are ratioed strong
*   against the latch PMOS so the latch flips on both clock edges.
*
*   All PMOS wells sit on ntop, the highest node in the core, so no
*   source/drain junction is ever forward biased when the boost is active.
*
*   Geometry note: the BSIM bin is picked from the total w while the binned
*   parameters are evaluated at w/nf, so only (w,nf) pairs verified against
*   the sky130 continuous models are used here.
**********************************************************************
.subckt boot_core vdd vss clk clkb clkd vin gate

Cboot ntop nbot 2p

* --- hold-phase refresh -----------------------------------------------
XMCHP  ntop  nag   vdd   ntop  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
XMCHN  nbot  clkd  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
XMGND  gate  clkd  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5

* --- track-phase connection -------------------------------------------
XMPASS gate  npg   ntop  ntop  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
XMIN   nbot  gate  vin   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4

* --- cross-coupled boosted level shifter ------------------------------
XMYP   nag   npg   ntop  ntop  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMYN   nag   clk   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMXP   npg   nag   ntop  ntop  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMXN   npg   clkb  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

.ends boot_core

**********************************************************************
* Differential driver
**********************************************************************
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* prompt complement
XI1N   clkb clk  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XI1P   clkb clk  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* delayed in-phase copy for the pull-downs
XI2N   clkd clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
XI2P   clkd clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8

XBP    vdd vss clk clkb clkd vinp gatep boot_core
XBN    vdd vss clk clkb clkd vinn gaten boot_core

.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrapped gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
* clk = 0 -> track: gate = vin + VDD, so the fixed 64u/0.15u sampling switch
*                   sees a constant, input-independent overdrive.
* clk = 1 -> hold:  gate clamped to vss and the flying cap is refreshed to VDD.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
XBP vdd vss clk vinp gatep boot_half
XBN vdd vss clk vinn gaten boot_half
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

* One single-ended bootstrap cell driving one sampling-switch gate.
.subckt boot_half vdd vss clk vin vg
* Flying bootstrap capacitor: nt is the top plate, nb the bottom plate.
CBOOT nt nb 2p
* Hold (vg = 0): refresh the top plate to VDD.
* Track (vg follows nt): gate and source rise together, so this device stays off
* and never forward-biases its well, which is tied to the boosted top plate.
XMCHG nt vg vdd nt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
* Track: tie the boosted top plate to the sampling-switch gate.
XMPASS vg clk nt nt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
* Hold: clamp the sampling-switch gate to vss.
XMPDG vg clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Hold: return the bottom plate to vss so the cap can recharge.
XMPDB nb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Track: bottom plate follows the sampled input.
XMNIN nb vg vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
.ends boot_half

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a clk=0-track / clk=1-hold sampler.
*
* Each half (bsg_half) is a constant-VGS bootstrap:
*   hold  (clk=1): CB is charged to VDD (bot -> vss via MNB, top -> vdd via MPT)
*                  and the switch gate g is pulled to vss by a cascoded pull-down.
*   track (clk=0): CB is inserted between vin (bot, via MNIN) and g (top, via MPS),
*                  so g ~ vin + VDD*CB/(CB+Cpar) and the switch VGS is ~constant.
* The sampling edge is set by the pull-down MND2, whose gate is driven directly
* by clk for a fast, signal-independent gate fall.  MPZ2 (gate g) pulls the MPS
* gate up to top as soon as g starts to fall, so MPS turns off regeneratively
* instead of fighting the pull-down.  The MND1 cascode (gate at vdd) splits the
* boosted gate voltage so MND2 never sees more than about VDD.

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* ckb = track enable (active high), ckh = hold enable (active high)
XI1N ckb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XI1P ckb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XI2N ckh ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XI2P ckh ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XHP vdd vss clk ckh ckb vinp gatep bsg_half
XHN vdd vss clk ckh ckb vinn gaten bsg_half
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

.subckt bsg_half vdd vss clk ckh ckb vin g
* bootstrap capacitor between top and bot plates
CB top bot 1.5p
* hold: bot -> vss, top -> vdd (MPT gate is g; its n-well is tied to top)
XMNB bot ckh vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMPT top g vdd top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* track: top -> g through MPS, bot -> vin through MNIN
XMPS g gz top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNIN vin g bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* MPS gate control: gz -> vdd/top in hold, gz -> bot (= vin) in track
XMPZ gz ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPZ2 gz g top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNK gz ckb bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNZ gz g bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* hold: g -> vss through the cascoded pull-down
XMND1 g vdd nd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XMND2 nd clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
.ends bsg_half

.subckt bg_half vdd vss clk trk vin gate
* Bootstrap storage capacitor (ideal C permitted for bootstrap energy storage).

* Bottom plate to vss during hold.
XMNBG bot clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
* Bottom plate follows the input during track (its gate is bootstrapped).
XMNBI bot gate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

XMPP gate s4g top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

XMPK s4g gate top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMNK s4g trk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a track-and-hold sampler.
* clk=0 tracks: gate = vin + (voltage stored on CBOOT, ~VDD).
* clk=1 holds: gate is pulled to vss while CBOOT recharges to VDD.

* One bootstrapped gate-driver half.
* x = CBOOT bottom plate, y = CBOOT top plate, z = gate of the series PMOS XMS.
.subckt bootstrap_half vdd vss clk clkb clkd vin gate
CBOOT y x 2.5p
* Hold: recharge CBOOT between vdd and vss. The bottom-plate pulldown uses the
* delayed clock so it cannot drag x/y/gate while the sampling edge is in progress.
XMXG x clkd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMYV vdd gate y y sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
* Hold: strong cascoded gate pulldown; its falling edge sets the sampling instant.
XMGC gate vdd ng vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
XMGD ng clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=12
* Hold: keep XMS off. XMZY ties z to y as soon as the gate falls, so the
* pulldown does not have to discharge the top plate through XMS.
XMZV z clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMZY z gate y y sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Track: connect CBOOT between vin and the gate.
XMS gate z y y sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMXIN x gate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMZX z gate x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Track start: pull z to the (grounded) bottom plate to turn XMS on.
XMZK z clkb x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends bootstrap_half

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* clkb = inverted clock.
XINVN clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINVP clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* clkd = skewed re-inversion: slow rise (a few hundred ps after the sampling
* edge) but fast fall, so XMXG releases x promptly when tracking starts.
XDLYN clkd clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDLYP clkd clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XHP vdd vss clk clkb clkd vinp gatep bootstrap_half
XHN vdd vss clk clkb clkd vinn gaten bootstrap_half
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential bootstrapped gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
* Clock convention (set by the testbench): clk = 0 tracks, the clk rising edge
* starts a 4 ns hold.  Each half drives one fixed 64/0.15 NMOS sampling switch
* with a gate voltage of vin + ~0.9*VDD, so the switch VGS - and therefore its
* on-resistance, its channel charge and the instant at which it opens - are
* almost independent of the input level.  That input independence is what buys
* the SDR; a fixed (non-tracking) gate drive would modulate both the aperture
* and the injected charge with the signal.
*
* Only the boost capacitors are ideal; everything else is transistor level.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* Local track-phase clock, shared by both halves.  Deliberately asymmetric:
* the strong NMOS gives a fast falling edge, so at the hold edge the bottom
* plate is released from the input immediately; the weak PMOS delays the
* rising edge, which guarantees the start-up ordering described below.
XCKN clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XCKP clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XHP vdd vss clk clkb vinp gatep boot_half
XHN vdd vss clk clkb vinn gaten boot_half
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* One bootstrapped gate driver.  a = boost capacitor top plate, b = bottom.
*
*   hold  (clk = 1): a -> vdd, b -> vss, gate -> vss.  CBOOT is refreshed to
*                    VDD and the sampling switch is held hard off.
*   track (clk = 0): a -> gate, b -> vin.  The floating capacitor lifts the
*                    gate to vin + VDD*Cb/(Cb + Cpar).
*
* Track-edge ordering matters.  XMPASS closes first (its gate is clk, and it
* turns on as soon as clk falls below Va - |Vtp|), so charge sharing pulls the
* gate up and switches XMPRE off before clkb has risen far enough to connect b
* to vin.  Without that ordering XMPRE would clamp a to vdd and shunt the
* boost charge back into the supply.
*
* Sizing notes: CBOOT is ~14x the total parasitic loading of the gate node, so
* VGS stays above 0.87*VDD at 1.3 V input over all corners while the residual
* VGS-vs-input slope stays small.  XMPD is much stronger than XMPASS so the
* gate-node discharge - i.e. the sampling instant - is set by XMPD alone and

circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for the 100 MS/s track-and-hold.
* clk = 0 : track   (sampling-switch gate rides at vin + ~vdd)
* clk = 1 : hold    (gate pulled to vss, bootstrap capacitor recharged)
*
* Per side a bootstrap capacitor Cbo is tied between a floating top plate
* (boot) and a source-sense plate (src).  During hold src is grounded and
* boot is recharged from vdd through a PMOS whose gate is the sampling-gate
* node itself (gate).  Because that node is at vss during hold, the recharge
* is a full vdd switch with no threshold drop; when the gate later rides up
* on the bootstrap during track, the same device is hard off with Vgs = 0,
* so it can never clamp or load the flying top plate.  The strong gate
* pull-down also sharpens the sampling edge, keeping the sampling instant
* well defined.  A small clock-doubler generates the high-side gate drive
* so the charge switch (XTOP) cuts off before the gate pull-down drags the
* bootstrap node down.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* ---- local clock buffer (keeps the source clk lightly loaded) ----
XIN1N cka clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIN1P cka clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* non-inverted clock driver
XIN2N ck cka vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIN2P ck cka vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* inverted clock driver
XIN3N ckb ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIN3P ckb ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8

* ---- boosted clock used to turn the high-side PMOS off quickly ----
CBST ck bst 0.22p
XDB vdd vdd bst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPTG tg ckb bst bst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XNTG tg ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* =========================== positive side ===========================
CBP bootp srcp 6p
* full-vdd recharge of the bootstrap capacitor, gated by the sampling gate
* (on only while the gate is low, i.e. during hold)
XCHGP bootp gatep vdd bootp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
* high-side switch: connects boot to the sampling gate during track
XTOPP gatep tg bootp bootp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
* sampling-gate pull-down (hold phase, strong to sharpen the sampling edge)
XPDNP gatep ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56 nf=28
* source-sense plate: ground clamp during hold
XBGP srcp ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
* bootstrapped gate for the source-sense switch: on with Vgs = Vcap

XTGN tggp ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XBVNP srcp tggp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

XCHGN bootn gaten vdd bootn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12

* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz differential track-and-hold.
* clk = 0 : TRACK  -> sampling switch on, gate driven to vin + VDD by the bootstrap cap
* clk = 1 : HOLD   -> sampling switch off, bootstrap cap recharged to VDD
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* ---- clock regeneration: the testbench clock edge is slow, so it is
* ---- re-buffered here to give the switch a sharp turn-off edge.
XIN1N clkn clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XIN1P clkn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIN2N clki clkn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIN2P clki clkn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* clkb is high during track
XIN3N clkb clki vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIN3P clkb clki vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8

XBP vdd vss clki clkb vinp gatep bstrap_side
XBN vdd vss clki clkb vinn gaten bstrap_side
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

.subckt bstrap_side vdd vss clk clkb vin gate
CBOOT top bot 2p

* pgate sits at vss in hold and rides on top in track.  It drives the
* precharge PFET (so it is off whenever the cap is lifted above vdd) and the
* bottom-plate switch gate, so the bottom plate can follow the whole input
* range even at slow / 1.62 V corners where a clk-driven gate cannot.
XPD pgate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XPU pgate clk top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* hold: recharge the bootstrap cap top plate to vdd
XPA top pgate vdd top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* hold: bootstrap cap bottom plate to vss
XBV bot clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* track: bootstrap cap bottom plate to vin, gated by the boosted rail so
* the pass device stays on over the full input range
XBTN bot pgate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* hold: pull the switch gate to vss
XGD gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* track: connect the switch gate to the bootstrap cap top plate
XPS gate clk top top sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends bstrap_side

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
* Each side keeps a bootstrap capacitor charged to vdd while the clock is high
* (hold) with its bottom plate at vss, then re-references the bottom plate to
* the input during track so the sampling-switch gate sits at vin + vdd.
* The floating gate driver is an inverter supplied by the bootstrap rails, so
* the sampling switch gate swings vss -> vin + vdd with no static current.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* complementary clock for the bottom-plate transmission gates
XCLKP clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3
XCLKN clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2

* ---------------- positive side ----------------
CBP ra_p rb_p 2p
* boosted gate drive for the charging device (clk coupled onto a diode-clamped node)
CXP bg_p clk 150f
XDP bg_p vdd vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMCHGP ra_p bg_p vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* floating-supply gate driver
XGPU gatep clk ra_p ra_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XGPD gatep clk rb_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* bottom plate: vss during hold, vinp during track
XRBDNP rb_p clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XRBTNP rb_p clkb vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XRBTGP rb_p clk vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=8

* ---------------- negative side ----------------
CBN ra_n rb_n 2p
CXN bg_n clk 150f
XDN bg_n vdd vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMCHGN ra_n bg_n vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XGNU gaten clk ra_n ra_n sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XGND gaten clk rb_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XRBDNN rb_n clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XRBTNN rb_n clkb vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XRBTGN rb_n clk vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=8

.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a track-and-hold sampler.
*
* Top level: two single-ended bootstrap cells.  Each cell drives one of the
* fixed testbench sampling switches so that, during tracking (clk=0), the
* switch gate sits at about VDD+Vin and the switch sees an almost constant
* VGS ~ VDD.  During hold (clk=1) the gate is pulled hard to VSS and the
* bootstrap capacitor is recharged to VDD.
*
* Pin order: vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* Positive side
XCELLP vdd vss clk vinp gatep bootstrap_cell
* Negative side
XCELLN vdd vss clk vinn gaten bootstrap_cell
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

* Single-ended bootstrap cell.  Pins: vdd vss clk vin gate
.subckt bootstrap_cell vdd vss clk vin gate
* Bootstrap energy storage (ideal capacitor allowed by the task).
CBOOT n1 n2 4p
* Pass device: tie top plate n1 to the switch gate during tracking (clk=0).
* Bulk tied to the bootstrapped top plate so the source-bulk junction never
* forward-biases when n1 is boosted above VDD.
XPASS gate clk n1 n1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Precharge device: recharge n1 to VDD during hold.  Its gate is the output
* gate node, so once n1 is boosted above VDD it turns itself off.  Bulk tied
* to n1 (the bootstrapped node) to avoid forward-biasing when n1 > VDD.
XPRE n1 gate vdd n1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Pull the switch gate to VSS during hold.
XPD gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Bottom plate to VSS during hold (precharge).
XBOTPRE n2 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Bottom plate to Vin during tracking.  Driven by the (boosted) gate node
* itself, so it stays strongly on for the full input range.
XMBOT n2 gate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
.ends bootstrap_cell

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a track-and-hold sampler.
* clk = 0 : track, clk = 1 : hold.
*
* Per side the bootstrap capacitor Cb is charged to VDD during hold with the
* top plate (nt) pulled to vdd by MP1 and the bottom plate (nb) pulled to vss
* by MNB.  During track MNB2 ties nb to the input, so the top plate flies to
* vin+VDD; MPPG then connects that boosted plate to the sampling-switch gate.
* MNPG hard-pulls the gate to vss at the hold edge (clk rises), and MP1 is
* re-enabled by the same edge.  The bottom-plate switch MNB2 is gated by the
* gate node itself, so its VGS equals the bootstrap capacitor voltage
* (independent of the input level) and it stays off during hold.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* ---------------- side P ----------------
CBP ntp nbp 4p
XMP1P ntp gatep vdd ntp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMNPgP gatep clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XMPPgP gatep clk ntp ntp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNBP nbp clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMNB2P nbp gatep vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
* ---------------- side N ----------------
CBN ntn nbn 4p
XMP1N ntn gaten vdd ntn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMNPgN gaten clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XMPPgN gaten clk ntn ntn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNBN nbn clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMNB2N nbn gaten vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Bootstrap gate driver for a differential track-and-hold sampler.
* clk=0 -> track: gatep = vinp + VDD, gaten = vinn + VDD (constant VGS ~ VDD).
* clk=1 -> hold:  gatep = 0,        gaten = 0          (switches off).
* Ideal capacitors (C) are used for bootstrap energy storage; no R/L/S.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* Local inverted clock (buffered to drive the bootstrap devices).
XI1N clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XI1P clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* ---- Positive side: gatep follows vinp + VDD during track ----
* Precharge top plate to VDD during hold (PMOS, bootstrapped well = Tp).
XPpreT Tp clkb vdd Tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Precharge bottom plate to VSS during hold.
XPpreB Pp clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* Connect input to bottom plate during track (transmission gate).
XPin Pp clkb vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XPinP Pp clk vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
* Pass the bootstrapped top plate to the gate during track (PMOS, well = Tp).
XPpass Tp clk gatep Tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Pull the gate to VSS during hold.
XPoff gatep clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
Cbp Tp Pp 8p
* ---- Negative side: gaten follows vinn + VDD during track ----
XNpreT Tn clkb vdd Tn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XNpreB Pn clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XNin Pn clkb vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XNinP Pn clk vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XNpass Tn clk gaten Tn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNoff gaten clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
Cbn Tn Pn 8p
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a track-and-hold sampler.
*
* Each sampling switch is driven by its own bootstrapped gate:
*   - hold (clk=1): gate pulled to vss (switch off), bootstrap cap precharged to vdd
*   - track (clk=0): gate = vin + vdd (switch on, VGS ~ vdd constant)
*
* Per-side bootstrap cell (top plate nt, bottom plate nb):
*   Mpass (PMOS, bulk=nt) connects nt to the switch gate during track.
*   Mpret (PMOS, bulk=nt, gate=gate) precharges nt to vdd during hold and
*          self-disables once the gate catches up to nt during track.
*   Mbot  (NMOS, gate=gate) connects nb to vin during track.
*   Mdis / Mpreb discharge the gate / bottom plate during hold.
*
.subckt boot vdd vss clk vin gate
Cboot nt nb 1p
XMdis  gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMpreb nb   clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMpret nt   gate vdd nt  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMpass gate clk nt  nt  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMbot  nb   gate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
.ends boot

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
XBOOTP vdd vss clk vinp gatep boot
XBOOTN vdd vss clk vinn gaten boot
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver.
* Two identical bootstrapped channels: during track (clk=0) the bootstrap
* capacitor is connected across the sampling switch gate-source so
* V(gate) ~= vin + VDD; during hold (clk=1) the gate is pulled to vss
* and the capacitor is re-precharged to VDD.
.subckt bootstrap_ch vdd vss clk vin g
cbts btop bbot 1.5p
* Hold devices (clk high): strong gate pull-down for a steep, signal-level
* independent switch aperture; bottom-plate pull-down.
xmpd  g    clk vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
xmbt  bbot clk vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4  nf=2
* Precharge path vdd->btop. Gate follows g: during track g~=btop so the
* device is hard off (no bootstrap leakage); during hold g=0 so it is on
* and clamps btop to vdd. Bulk tied to btop to avoid forward body diode.
xmpc  vdd  g   btop btop sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4  nf=2
* Track devices (clk low): pmos connects btop to gate; nmos connects the
* bottom plate to vin, gated by the bootstrapped node g (fully on over the
* whole input range, hard off in hold).
xmtop g    clk btop btop sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
xmin  vin  g   bbot vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
.ends bootstrap_ch

.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
xchp vdd vss clk vinp gatep bootstrap_ch
xchn vdd vss clk vinn gaten bootstrap_ch
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver.
* clk=0 tracks (sampling switches on), clk rising edge begins hold.
* Per side a bootstrap capacitor Cboot sits between bt (top) and bb (bottom):
*   Hold (clk high): MP (5V pmos, gate=switch gate) precharges bt to vdd and
*       MB (nfet, gate=clk) pulls bb to vss, so Cboot is charged to vdd within
*       the hold phase; MPD (5V nfet, gate=clk) pulls the sampling-switch gate
*       to vss, turning the sampling switch off.
*   Track (clk low): MG (5V pmos, gate=clk) connects bt to the sampling-switch
*       gate while MIN (nfet, gate=switch gate) connects bb to vin; the pre-
*       charged Cboot then boots bt and the gate to vin+vdd, holding VGS ~ vdd
*       independent of vin. MP self-biases off once the gate boots; MPD/MB are
*       off so there is no track-mode crowbar. MG/MP wells tie to bt so no
*       source/drain-to-well junction forward-biases when bt rises above vdd.
* 1.8 V nfets use 2 um fingers to stay inside the characterised BSIM bins.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* ---- p-side ----
CBTP   btp bbp 3p
XMGP   gatep clk btp btp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=9 nf=2
XMPP   vdd   gatep btp btp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=28 nf=2
XMINP  vinp  gatep bbp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMBP   bbp   clk   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMPDP  gatep clk   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5  l=0.5 w=18 nf=2
* ---- n-side ----
CBTN   btn bbn 3p
XMGN   gaten clk btn btn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=9 nf=2
XMPN   vdd   gaten btn btn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=28 nf=2
XMINN  vinn  gaten bbn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMBN   bbn   clk   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMPDN  gaten clk   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5  l=0.5 w=18 nf=2
.ends bootstrap_gate_driver

taskTitle: Design a 100 MHz Differential Bootstrap Gate Driver
circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for the track-and-hold sampler.
* clk=0 tracks, clk=1 holds (4 ns). Each side bootstraps its sampling
* switch gate to src+VDD during track and clamps it to vss during hold.
*
* Single-ended half (nodes):
*   A  - bootstrap capacitor top plate (vdd in hold, src+vdd in track)
*   B  - bootstrap capacitor bottom plate (0 in hold, src in track)
*   G  - output gate of the external sampling switch
*   G5 - self-boosted gate rail (0 in hold -> A in track); gates the
*        track-mode links and is inverted to drive the pass-PMOS gate G6
*   G6 - gate of the A-to-G pass PMOS (0 in track -> on; A in hold -> off)
* Devices touching voltages above vdd are 5 V-tolerant g5v0d10v5; PMOS
* wells tie to A (highest potential), NMOS bulks tie to vss. Every HV
* instance keeps total width <= 12 um (2 um fingers): the PDK model bin
* for w=15..20 um at l=0.5 um has invalid corner parameters; extra drive
* uses parallel instances instead.
.subckt boot_half vdd vss clk src gate
CB A B 2p
* Precharge A to vdd in hold: gate=G5 (0 in hold -> on, A in track -> off).
XMP  vdd G5 A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XMP2 vdd G5 A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Pull B to vss in hold (w8/nf4: testbench-proven safe geometry bin).
XM1 B clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* Clamp the sampling-switch gate to vss in hold. Strong, clk-driven:
* a hard, sharp gate fall gives a well-defined sampling instant.
XM3  gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM3B gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM3C gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM3D gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Link src to B in track (gate self-boosted to A, Vgs=VDD).
XM5  src G5 B vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM5B src G5 B vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Pull G6 to vss in track, sharing the boosted G5 rail (Vgs=VDD).
XN1 G6 G5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
* Drive G5 to A in track (clk low).
XM5A G5 clk A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Clamp G5 to B (0) in hold (strong, so the pass device turns off promptly).
XM5C  G5 clk B vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM5CD G5 clk B vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Pass PMOS: connect A to the switch gate in track (G6=0, Vsg=A).
XM6  gate G6 A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XM6B gate G6 A A sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Hold (slow tail): once G5 falls, pull G6 fully to A.

*     is on while the gate node is low (hold, pinning xp to vdd) and off as
*     soon as the node is boosted (VGS ~ 0).

circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
* clk = 0 -> track: sampling switch gate driven to vin + VDD (constant VGS)
* clk = 1 -> hold : sampling switch gate pulled to vss, bootstrap reservoir
*                   precharged to VDD (top plate to vdd, bottom plate to vss)
*
* Ideal capacitors are used only for bootstrap energy storage.

*----- single-ended bootstrap channel --------------------------------------
.subckt boot_ch vdd vss clk clkb vin gate
* bootstrap reservoir (top plate n1, bottom plate n2)
Cboot n1 n2 12p
* precharge the top plate to vdd during hold, vdd -> mid -> n1.
* While tracking, n1 rises to vin+VDD (above vdd); a PMOS with its gate at
* vdd would then conduct from n1 back into the supply and discharge the
* reservoir.  M1B is gated by the bootstrapped gate node (gate ~ n1 while
* tracking), so it sees VSG ~ 0 and blocks; M1A (gate = clkb) turns off
* promptly when tracking starts, which bounds the transition shoot-through.
* The stack is wide so the reservoir is restored in ~1 ns (a slow restore
* leaves a cycle-to-cycle buildup that spans the record and costs SDR).
* Bulks ride on the higher terminal so no well junction is ever forward.
XM1B n1 gate mid n1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
XM1A mid clkb vdd mid sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
* discharge bottom plate to vss during hold
XM2 n2 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
* connect bottom plate to vin during track:
*   NMOS gate is driven by the bootstrapped gate node itself (flat, high VGS)
*   PMOS (bulk on vin, so no body effect) starts the high-vin transient

XM3P n2 clk vin vin sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
* transfer the boosted level to the sampling switch gate during track
XM4 n1 clk gate n1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
* pull the sampling switch gate low during hold.  Wide on purpose: the
* reservoir island (12 pF) must be yanked down fast at the clock edge, or
* the sampling instant drifts with vin (this was the dominant HD3 source).
XM5 gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=12
.ends boot_ch

*----- top level ------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten
* shared clock inverter (drives the lower precharge devices)
XINN clkb clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XINP clkb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8

XBN vdd vss clk clkb vinn gaten boot_ch

* clk=0: track; clk rising edge: hold begins.

* During track a transmission gate (X5N/X5P) connects bp to vinp so the
* sampling FET sees Vgs ~= capacitor voltage (nearly constant).
* At the hold edge the gate is dumped toward ba-Vtn by stack X3A/X3B

* negative kick (CPK driven by delayed clkb, gated through X6) re-deepens
* bp; junction leakage self-limits the park depth.

* edge: charge caps CCA/CCB (charged to VDD during the previous hold) are
* shared into CVP/CBA (discharged to 0 during track). mp = vp + Vtn.

circuit:
* Differential bootstrap gate driver for a 100 MHz track-and-hold sampler.
*
* Per-side bootstrapped switch topology (classic Abo-Gray style):
*   During hold (clk=1): the bootstrap capacitor is precharged with VDD
*   (top plate A -> VDD, bottom plate B -> 0) and the sampling gate G is
*   pulled to 0 by M6, keeping the sampling switch off.
*   During track (clk=0): the bottom plate B is connected to the input,
*   so the top plate, coupled to the gate through PMOS M2, settles at
*   vin + VDD, giving VGS = VDD (constant vs input) for the sampling
*   switch.

.subckt boot_cell vdd vss clk clkb vin gate
* Bootstrap energy storage capacitor (ideal C permitted).
CB a b 2.5p
* Precharge top plate to VDD during hold (clkb=0). Body tied to A so the
* PMOS well does not forward-bias when A swings above VDD.
XMP7 a clkb vdd a sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2
* Hold pull-down for the sampling gate (low-Vt for fast cutoff).
XM6 gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=4
* Couple top plate A to gate G during track (clk=0). Body tied to A.
XM2 gate clk a a sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=2
* Discharge bottom plate B to VSS during hold (clk=1).
XM8 b clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2

* Transmission gate: the NMOS covers low inputs, the PMOS covers the
* upper range where an NMOS would be cut off by body effect.

circuit:
* Bootstrap gate driver for the differential NMOS sampling switches.
* clk high = hold, clk low = track.
*
* Per side: bootstrap cap CBOOT between top_x and bot_x.
*   hold  : top_x precharged to VDD (XS2), bot_x to vss (XS3),
*           sampling gate pulled to vss (XS5).
*   track : top_x tied to the sampling gate (XS1), bot_x pinned to the
*           input (XS4 TG), so gate = vin + Vcap with Vcap ~ VDD and
*           constant over the input swing.
* The clk pin is lightly loaded; a local tapered buffer regenerates it as
* clki, which drives the pumps and all gated switches with fast edges at
* every corner.  vh is a clock-pumped copy of clki clamped three Vth below
* VDD: low in track to turn XS1 on hard, high in hold to keep it off.
* pg2 is pumped with an LVT-diode clamp so XS2 fully precharges top_x.
* XS5 is gated by clki directly: it discharges the sampling gate right at
* the sampling edge.  XS1 cuts off with the edge (vh jumps up), so the
* brief XS1/XS5 overlap only bleeds a little CBOOT charge, which XS2's
* precharge restores every hold phase.
.subckt bootstrap_gate_driver vdd vss clk vinp vinn gatep gaten

* ---- local clock buffer: clk -> n1 -> clki (in phase, strong) ----
XB1P n1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XB1N n1 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XB2P clki n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XB2N clki n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=6
* clkb = inverted clki (high during track), drives the XS4 NMOS gates
XB3P clkb clki vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XB3N clkb clki vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* ---- pumps (driven from clki) ----
* vh pump: three-diode NMOS stack clamps vh ~ VDD - 3*Vthn in track;
* the clki-coupled cap lifts it by ~VDD during hold.

XDH2 vhm1 vhm1 vhm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8
XDH3 vhm2 vhm2 vh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8
CDHM vhm2 vss 50f
CFH clki vh 250f
* pg2 pump: LVT-diode clamp keeps pg2 ~ VDD - Vthn,lvt in track.
XDP vdd vdd pg2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=10
CFP clki pg2 250f

* ---- p side ----

* top plate <-> gate; nwell tied to top plate (node exceeds VDD in track)

* precharge top plate to VDD during hold

* bottom plate to vss during hold
XS3P bot_p clki vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8

* Negative sampling-switch gate.
XN vdd vss clk clkb vinn gaten bootchan

* Single-channel bootstrap core.
*   Cboot flying cap precharged to VDD during hold, then stacked between vin
*   and gate during track so gate = vin + Vboot ~= vin + VDD -> constant VGS.
*   The top plate rises above VDD during track, so every PMOS that touches it
*   uses a floating nwell (= top plate).  The high-side PMOS gates (M1, M5) are
*   driven to max(vdd,top) in their off phase (two PMOS: one to vdd, one to the
*   top plate) so they stay hard off for ALL signal levels -- without this, a
*   droop at low vin lets the top plate fall below VDD-VTH and the precharge
*   PMOS re-conducts, collapsing the bootstrap voltage.

* Pull gate to vss during hold (sampling switch off).
XM3 gate clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
